dct_description_sm: This image service is a mosaic of colour digital air photos of the municipality of Kingston, Ontario captured as part of the Digital Raster Acquisition Project for the East (DRAPE) project in spring 2019. UTM Zone 18, NAD83 projection. Original images captured at 20cm resolution, CSRS projection
